title: Bear cub reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bear body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='18' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#E8C07A'/>
  
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='45' r='20' fill='#C68642'/>
  <!-- Inner ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='29' r='8' fill='#C68642'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='29' r='4.5' fill='#E8A87C'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='29' r='8' fill='#C68642'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='29' r='4.5' fill='#E8A87C'/>
  
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#E8C07A'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='4' ry='2.8' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 52 Q46 56 50 57 Q54 56 50 52' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  
  <!-- Eyes looking down at book -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3B1F07'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='43' rx='3.5' ry='4' fill='#3B1F07'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Eyebrows raised in happy interest -->
  <path d='M37 37 Q42 34 46 37' stroke='#4A2C0A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 37 Q58 34 63 37' stroke='#4A2C0A' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='70' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#C68642' transform='rotate(-20 26 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='70' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#C68642' transform='rotate(20 74 70)'/>
  
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x='32' y='60' width='36' height='24' rx='2' fill='#D4453A'/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x='47' y='60' width='6' height='24' rx='1' fill='#A8322A'/>
  <!-- Book pages (left) -->
  <rect x='34' y='63' width='13' height='18' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- Book pages (right) -->
  <rect x='53' y='63' width='13' height='18' rx='1' fill='#FFF8E7'/>
  <!-- Text lines on pages -->
  <line x1='37' y1='67' x2='45' y2='67' stroke='#B0A090' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='70' x2='44' y2='70' stroke='#B0A090' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='37' y1='73' x2='45' y2='73' stroke='#B0A090' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='67' x2='64' y2='67' stroke='#B0A090' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='70' x2='63' y2='70' stroke='#B0A090' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='73' x2='64' y2='73' stroke='#B0A090' stroke-width='1'/>
  
  <!-- Little paw pads on arms -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='70' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#8B5E34'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='70' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#8B5E34'/>
  
  <!-- Happy cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E88A7A' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='50' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E88A7A' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
